---
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: true
    run:
      extension-test:
        check: |-
          text="$(pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | tr '\n' ' ')"
          for expected in 'Figure 1.1: A first square.' 'Figure 2.1: A second square.' 'Figure S1: A supplementary square.' 'Figure 3.1: A third square.' '(3.1)' 'See Figure 3.1 and Chapter 3.'; do
            printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qF "$expected" || { echo "missing: $expected"; exit 1; }
          done
          pdftotext "$EXTENSION_TEST_OUTPUT" - | grep -qE '^.?3\. Third chapter$' || { echo "the third chapter is not numbered 3"; exit 1; }
          ! printf '%s' "$text" | grep -qE 'S[2-9]|Figure 2\.1: A third' || { echo "the third chapter continues the supplementary numbering"; exit 1; }
---

# Preface {.unnumbered}

The preface.
